title: Dispatch CTW 9: The Telegraph Office Marks an Unsent Warning Delivered
summary: No new voice is heard on the restored line.
topic: The Choir in the Telegraph Wires
author: Clara Vale, Staff Correspondent
paragraphs: The Post Office has closed its inquiry. Hollow Junction’s wire will remain disconnected from public traffic, with a labelled section preserved for study. The repaired bridge is in service, and the eastbound trains are running on schedule.

Mr. Bell placed the old hold order in the log beside the message his staff sent this month. The interval between them is one hundred thirty-four years. He left the space for a receiving operator’s signature blank.
